# Aloita tästä: repository start page generated by a skill

## Description

Jari 2026-10-21 (clarifying proto-skill-catalogue): the content of the "Aloita tästä" page is generated into the repository itself, for example by a dedicated skill, not assembled from per-skill frontmatter flags. implement-start-here delivered the empty state, catalogue and native skill reading with starting goals marked in each skill's frontmatter; this issue replaces that source.

Deliver:
- One committed start-page file in the repository (worker chooses path and format, preferably under `.agents/` or `.pi/` next to the skills, human-readable Markdown with light structure): a short intro and a handful of starting goals, each with title, when to use, example prompt and optionally the skill it uses. The daemon reads it as the person from the workspace, the empty state renders it; no file means only "Tutustu taitoihin" and a hint on how to create the page.
- A skill that writes or refreshes that file by reading the repository's effective skills and the repository itself, proposing the text for the person to review and commit (it never commits or pushes on its own). Open Habitat provides this skill to every user on the host, so a team can run it in any repository; the worker chooses the native Pi mechanism for providing it (and records the choice and alternatives under "Decisions for later review").
- Remove the per-skill `open-habitat-start` flag path, or keep it only if the generated file references skills by name; no two sources for the same list.

Done: contract/daemon/web changes with tests per TESTING.md, the skill with a usage example, KOKEILTAVAA.md entry in Finnish.

## Decisions

### 2026-10-21T17:00:57Z · @jari

2026-10-21 clarification received through conductor: the whole Aloita tästä view is manually defined in one repository start-page file. Markdown with YAML frontmatter: structured title and goal/skill entries in frontmatter, free text in the Markdown body. A maintainer proposes/updates it with the generating skill and shares ordinary commits; the skill never commits or pushes. No automatic skill list belongs in this view. Keep the separate catalogue only if independently reachable elsewhere; otherwise remove it. Without a page show only a short creation hint.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] One repository-authored Markdown/YAML start page defines the entire empty state; absent pages show only a creation hint.
- [x] The daemon confines and validates native page reads and resolves only explicitly authored effective skill references.
- [x] Every daemon-launched Open Habitat Pi receives the proposing-only authoring skill without personal settings writes; no skill commit/push action.
- [x] Catalogue removal, format/delivery choices, Finnish trial entry and synthetic evidence are recorded in result.md.
- [x] Fast web, affected browser/native tests, contract drift and independent final-diff review pass; the review finding is fixed.
